capabilities.title: Core declarations and statements
capabilities.summary: The native parser accepts modules, bindings, functions, control flow, and expression forms used by the runnable subset.

capabilities.title: Canonical semantic rejection
capabilities.summary: Unsupported or invalid language forms are rejected through parser or semantic diagnostics instead of legacy mode switches.

capabilities.title: Async and actor runtime closure
capabilities.summary: Async, task, and actor syntax and runtime concepts remain unavailable unless an entry is separately marked implemented here.

capabilities.title: JSON and schema registry helpers
capabilities.summary: Shared native and Python helpers own deterministic JSON rendering, strict JSON loading, schema lookup, and report envelopes.
